flagged.evidence: The page says “At the regular point, the transfer matrix is the oriented cyclic shift.” But [[lem-qsmx-transfer-regular-point]] states “t(0)=i^N U”; for N=3 this is t(0)=-iU, not U. The summary omits a scalar that changes the asserted equality.

The title says “Regular Bethe data diagonalize the transfer family,” which asserts a common eigenbasis. The Statement establishes an eigenpair for each specified nonzero regular datum and expressly makes “no ... completeness” claim, so it does not establish diagonalization of the family.

The item lists [[thm-qsmx-transfer-commutativity]] as a mathematical prerequisite, but its Definition uses the monodromy definition to construct the shifted operators, then defines regular data by root conditions and a nonzero vector. It makes no commutativity claim and does not use the commutativity theorem; this is an unnecessary logical dependency edge.

The item’s locator says “Section 4 ... equations (113)–(115).” In the cited [Faddeev PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-th/9605187), section 5 begins before equation (113), under the heading “XXX1/2 model. Physical spectrum in the ferromagnetic thermodynamic limit”; equations (113)–(115) therefore are not in section 4. The item's local proof still establishes its eigenvalue.
